votes.reason: NVDA is the purest play on my Technology call (rate relief plus the AI chain, and my thesis names the run-up to its Aug 26 report), and it led XLK's best week of 2026 at +11.6%, so Wednesday's CPI risk threatens the whole sector call, not this name in particular.

GOOGL is in my Technology call, my thesis cites Alphabet's +82% cloud growth as support for the AI chain, and at 17.8x it is less exposed to the hot-CPI and 10-year yield risk I named; it fell 0.5% while XLK rose 7.2%, which makes it a weaker rider of the rate-relief side of the call, but that is a caveat about fit, not a concrete reason to object.

ETN fits my Industrials call directly because the AI data-center power demand behind CAT's record Q2 and the ISM 55.6 factory upturn are its drivers, and at +8.3% on the week and +10.4% on the month it is leading the sector instead of trailing SPY, which is the failure my thesis warns about.

FCX is the copper and gold play on my Materials call (dollar index below 100, gold breakout, copper firming, the only sector beating SPY over both the week and the month), and it avoids NEM, the name my thesis flags as stretched.

LLY is my Healthcare hedge for CPI week, its raised $80-83B guidance is part of the earnings strength my thesis cites, and a modest +3.2% week leaves it unstretched; falling behind if a cool CPI pulls money out of defensives is the known cost of the hedge, not a reason against the name.
